parameters.name: FunctionBlockId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the custom TSL module. Each identifier is unique in a product.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default module is queried.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance. You can view the instance **ID** on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must configure this parameter. If you do not set this parameter, the call fails.
>*   If your instance has no **Overview** page or ID, you do not need to set this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ModelVersion
parameters.description:
The version number of the TSL model.

You can call the [ListThingModelVersion](~~150318~~) operation to view the version numbers of the TSL model for a product.

If you do not specify this parameter, the TSL model that is in the draft status is queried. If you specify this parameter, the TSL model of the specified version is queried.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group.

>  You cannot specify this parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-thing-model --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --resource-group-id rg-acfm4l5tcwd0000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --model-version v1.0.0 --function-block-id BatteryModule --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot QueryThingModel --region cn-hangzhou --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm4l5tcwd0000' --ModelVersion 'v1.0.0' --FunctionBlockId BatteryModule --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000
